reviews.author: Ayesha Munawer
reviews.text: I had a great experience learning automatic car driving at Punjab Driving Center. The instructors were calm, clear, and helped me feel comfortable on busy roads.

reviews.author: Shmran Ali
reviews.text: I had a great experience learning to drive at Punjab Driving Center. A special thanks to Instructor Zain for his patience, professionalism, and excellent teaching skills. He explained everything clearly and helped me build confidence behind the wheel.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks sir for this precious review

reviews.author: Ashfaq Hussain
reviews.text: I have completed my 10 days automatic car lessons with Madam Hadia from Punjab Driving School. She is an exceptional driving instructor who truly prioritizes her students' safety and progress.

reviews.author: Azba Butt
reviews.text: I recently completed a 10-day manual driving course at Punjab Driving Center, and I want to especially highlight the incredible support from my instructor Ms. Hadiya. She helped me overcome anxiety about driving in heavy traffic with patience and clear guidance.

reviews.author: Irrem Latif
reviews.text: I joined this driving school for learning driving. It was a very good experience. My instructor Mam Hadia taught me professionally with her competencies and expertise and encouraged me to overcome my fear of crazy traffic on the road.

reviews.author: Aimen Kashif
reviews.text: I had such a good experience at Punjab Driving Centre. My instructor Hadia was calm, friendly, and super clear with instructions. I completed my driving training in just 10 days and feel fully prepared. Definitely recommend this centre for professional training in a short time.

reviews.author: Hussain Ahmad
reviews.text: Very cooperative faculty. Zain and Shahmeer taught me very well about driving. They made classes a fun experience.

reviews.author: Tausif Asif
reviews.text: I recently completed my 10 days driving class successfully. My instructor Miss Hadiya was very cooperative, calm and humble. She built my confidence to face heavy traffic and taught me how to drive smoothly. I am very thankful to her.

reviews.author: Danish Ali
reviews.text: Best driving center in Lahore — my experience is very good and I'm so happy with them.

reviews.author: Noor Fatima
reviews.text: I am currently taking my driving classes at Punjab Driving Center with Miss Hadia, and I've had a great experience so far. She is really patient, calm, and explains everything clearly. I can already see a big improvement in my driving.

reviews.author: Aqsa Younas
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience learning driving from Madam Hadia. She is very kind, humble, and professional. She explains everything with patience, removes all fear, and builds confidence step by step.

reviews.author: Abdul Ghafoor
reviews.text: My experience at this driving school was fantastic! Moeed, my teacher, was professional, patient and well informed. He gave thorough explanations and gave me confidence when driving. I was able to rapidly enhance my skills because of his cool head and detailed instructions.

reviews.author: A Sial
reviews.text: Respected Hadia — your calm guidance and clear instructions made learning to drive a truly empowering experience. I always felt safe, supported, and confident behind the wheel because of your patience and professionalism.

reviews.author: Z
reviews.text: Miss Hadiya really is an amazing teacher! I'm highly satisfied with her methods and would thoroughly recommend her to all new learners. Her calm demeanor, positive attitude, and professionalism really helped me gain confidence.

reviews.author: Muhammad Yasir Mumtaz
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Punjab Driving Center! The instructors are extremely professional, punctual, and dedicated. I took lessons with Miss Hadia, and she made learning so easy and comfortable.

reviews.author: Laraib Sial
reviews.text: Very good experience with Ma'am Hadia. She is so polite, patient and helpful. Recommended if anyone is looking for a good driving instructor.

reviews.author: Hafiz Waheed
reviews.text: Instructor Hadia has amazing stamina for teaching, very confident and professional. My daughter had a great time learning how to drive with her. I strongly recommend this institute especially with Miss Hadia.

reviews.author: Nayab Sheikh
reviews.text: Miss Hadia — your teaching style has been both thorough and patient, making me feel comfortable and confident behind the wheel. You explained everything clearly, and I truly appreciated how you took the time with each lesson.

reviews.author: Mahnoor Naeem
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of taking driving lessons with Mam Hadia — she was very supportive and patient with me. She is an amazing teacher.

reviews.author: Zahra Firdous
reviews.text: Took driving lessons from Miss Hadia. Had a wonderful experience. She's firm yet friendly, and most importantly very clear with her instructions.

reviews.author: Ansa Majid
reviews.text: They focus on quality of instruction, patience, teaching methods, and ability to build confidence. Great overall learning experience, clean vehicles, and flexible scheduling.

reviews.author: Iqra Gulzar
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Hadia mam. Great experience of learning how to drive. I recommend to all of you, especially girls who are not comfortable with male instructors.

reviews.author: Sakina Iqbal
reviews.text: Haadia Aunty was an amazing teacher. She made sure that I was comfortable throughout and gave so much confidence. She also gave tips on how to drive better throughout our sessions which most instructors don't give.

reviews.author: Aiman Imran
reviews.text: Had a very good experience with them. I would definitely recommend it to everyone looking for a driving school and Ms. Hadia was a very good and friendly instructor.

reviews.author: Asghar Ali
reviews.text: Excellent service. My experience with Punjab driving school is amazing. My instructor is so polite and kind. Now I am able to drive confidently on roads. The behavior of office staff is so good. Sir Shahzad — best teacher, good driving school.

reviews.author: Pakistan Parkour Federation
reviews.text: My experience with the Punjab Driving Center was awesome. They give their full effort to help you learn driving as soon as possible in a professional way.

reviews.author: Nadia Faisal
reviews.text: Madam Hadia from Punjab Driving Center is an outstanding driving instructor. Her professionalism, patience, and ability to instill confidence make her an excellent choice, especially for female learners.

reviews.author: Ayesha Tariq
reviews.text: I've had a great experience with Miss Hadia. She imparted confidence in me right from day 1 and I was able to drive my own car just after five days of training. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sabahat Kashif
reviews.text: I have a great experience with my instructor ma'am Hadia — she's fully trained and skilled. It was a 10 days course but you can solo drive after fewer days when you're ready.

reviews.author: Anam Amjad
reviews.text: My experience with Punjab driving center was very good. Mam Hadia teaches you driving very professionally and early. She is fearless and makes you fearless while driving. Gives you so much confidence. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ismail Subhani
reviews.text: I am delighted to share my review for Punjab driving centre and their instructor, Shahmeer. I recently took lessons and it was a truly wonderful experience. He did a great job instructing me in automatic car operation.

reviews.author: Kanwal Zahra
reviews.text: I am delighted to share my review for Punjab Driving Center and their instructor, Shahmeer. I had an exceptional experience with him. He taught me both manual and automatic skills with patience.

reviews.author: Ifrah Sadaqat
reviews.text: Really good experience with them. Their female madam Hadia gave me driving classes on auto Honda City. She was always on time, professional, and built my confidence step by step.

reviews.author: Tayyaba Rana
reviews.text: Punjab driving centre is the best driving school in Lahore. Madam Zainab is the best instructor one could have. She teaches very politely and has amazing demonstrating qualities.

reviews.author: Ibraham Akhtar
reviews.text: My experience with Punjab Driving Center was very amazing — totally recommended.

reviews.author: Momina Adil
reviews.text: I had a really good experience. My instructor Hadia was very helpful and taught me well. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Mahroos Habib
reviews.text: My experience with Hadia is wonderful. It was my first time driving and in 10 days of training I am confident enough to drive the car on the main road.

reviews.author: Hareema Ahmad
reviews.text: In 10 days I am now able to drive my car around the city. The instructor Hadia was very helpful and it was a very good experience.

reviews.author: Maliha Zahid
reviews.text: Best driving school in Lahore. If you really want to learn how to drive then this is the place. Best for ladies, very professional. Mr. Shahzad is an excellent teacher.

reviews.author: Hammad Iftikhar
reviews.text: Best training instructor with reasonable prices. Multiple options depending on choice of cars, transmission (manual or automatic), duration of training per day and timings. Highly recommended for everyone.

reviews.author: Munawar Abbas Sial
reviews.text: Really fast service with pick and drop services and well maintained vehicles — both manual and automatic cars available at this Punjab coaching center.

reviews.author: Danish Raza
reviews.text: One of the best experiences with Punjab driving center in town — professional in dealing and they fulfill their commitments. Cooperative environment to learn. Strongly recommended.

reviews.author: Israr Ahmad
reviews.text: In just 10 days, this driving school transformed me from a complete beginner to a confident and skilled driver. The instructors' expertise, patience, and personalized approach were instrumental in my rapid progress.

reviews.author: Kamran Arshad
reviews.text: It was a great experience. Shahmeer is an outstanding coach. The services are simply amazing. I would definitely recommend Punjab Driving Center to beginners or people who want to polish their driving skills.

reviews.author: Tahira Butt
reviews.text: I have a great experience throughout all the days of driving. Mam Hadia is a skilled instructor. She taught me each and everything about driving. At first I didn't have confidence — she taught me how to handle the steering and traffic calmly.

reviews.author: Mehwish Boota
reviews.text: Mam Hadiya is my instructor — my experience with her is so good. She taught driving in a very good way. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Zainab Rashid
reviews.text: I joined as an amateur and 7 days later I feel like I can drive anywhere with enough practice! Ms. Hadia has been an incredible instructor!

reviews.author: Saad Sohail Khan
reviews.text: It's my 8th day with Mr. Shahzad, and they taught me driving from scratch brilliantly — not only driving, but road sense and ethics as well. I highly recommend him to those who want to become perfect drivers.

reviews.author: Asad Mahboob
reviews.text: Punjab driving school — best driving school in Lahore. Thank you so much Sir Zain.

reviews.author: Hira Wasti
reviews.text: Awesome experience with Miss Hadiya. She trained me very well. Highly appreciated the way of teaching — highly recommended.
